objects.name: a folded stack of evening papers

people.name: Concetta Marchetti
people.role: a shipping clerk who had come into money

secret.description: Filomena Vitale slips out to the Street from 9:00 PM to 9:30 PM to settle with a bookmaker.
Kathleen Sweeney is not the person the register says. Nothing is hidden about the evening; the lie is in the paperwork.
Adelaide Lathrop is alone with Concetta Marchetti in the Victim's Suite from 8:00 PM to 9:00 PM, and kills Concetta Marchetti at 9:00 PM.

people.name: Dennis Brennan
people.role: a bookmaker in a small way

secret.description: Dennis Brennan drinks alone in the Bar from 8:30 PM to 9:00 PM and will claim to have been anywhere else.

people.name: Constance Stannard
people.relationshipToVictim: a childhood friend of the victim from the same block

secret.description: Constance Stannard is with Thaddeus Havemeyer in the Service Stairs from 6:30 PM to 7:30 PM, and both will say they were somewhere else.

people.name: Thaddeus Havemeyer
people.role: a photographer for the rotogravure section

secret.description: Thaddeus Havemeyer is with Constance Stannard in the Service Stairs from 6:30 PM to 7:30 PM, and both will say they were somewhere else.

motive.description: wanted the victim out of a lease

method.name: poison in a drink
method.bodyEvidence: Chloral hydrate in the stomach. No wound, no bruising, no sign of a struggle.

Concetta Marchetti was found in the Victim's Suite. The coroner puts death between 8:30 PM and 9:00 PM. Chloral hydrate in the stomach. No wound, no bruising, no sign of a struggle.
A cut-glass decanter is missing from the Kitchen. The stopper has been wiped and the dregs test positive for chloral.
Rain began at 8:30 PM and did not let up. Anyone out on the street after that came back in wet.
Kathleen Sweeney says Filomena Vitale came in off the street at 10:30 PM with a soaked coat, so Filomena Vitale was outside at 10:00 PM.
Kathleen Sweeney's papers do not hold up. A union card in the coat lining carries a different surname and a 1919 date.
Found in the Victim's Suite: Three letters in Concetta Marchetti's hand to a woman Adelaide Lathrop is engaged to, kept in the drawer, the last one opened.
Morris Zeldin says Adelaide Lathrop told Concetta Marchetti to keep away, loud enough to turn heads.
Found in the Front Desk: A subpoena naming Concetta Marchetti as a witness before the grand jury, with Dennis Brennan's name written in the margin.
Thaddeus Havemeyer says Concetta Marchetti said to Dennis Brennan that a man who testifies sleeps better.
Found in the Victim's Suite: A lease assignment made out in Thaddeus Havemeyer's name, waiting only on Concetta Marchetti's signature.
Adelaide Lathrop says Concetta Marchetti told Thaddeus Havemeyer the lease would go to somebody else at the quarter day.
